answers.assumption_check: Measured: A seal over a proof that loads an extensionless repo file by path never names that file, so editing the file cannot stale the seal. 2026-11-20, eb2f8f9b0b8c: after bin/cmd/deletegate changed (82ab0b80a), the reseal-at-commit read test_delete_gate as 'settled red, closure unmoved' and did not rerun it; its fingerprint_closure was ['bin/proofs/test_delete_gate.py'] alone. Two filters each drop the file: the exec audit hook ticket 6e50ed204abc added keeps only co_filename ending '.py' (cairn/devices/tester/device.py:112), and repo_relative_closure keeps only rel paths ending '.py' (cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py:457). Scope, by a scan of every **/proofs/*.py: 56 proofs load by path (spec_from_file_location 45, SourceFileLoader 9, spec_from_loader 9, run_path 1, exec(compile 1); the 9 that load an extensionless file all use spec_from_loader(name, SourceFileLoader(name, path)) + exec_module, and are blind: bin/proofs/test_a_door_write_journaled_mid_pass_is_not_named.py (artifactgate); bin/proofs/test_a_record_path_refusal_names_every_way_out.py (artifactgate); bin/proofs/test_a_var_script_slot_runs_a_proof_only_through_its_loop.py (proofgate); bin/proofs/test_artifact_gate.py (artifactgate); bin/proofs/test_askscan.py (askscan); bin/proofs/test_delete_gate.py (deletegate, trash); bin/proofs/test_probescan.py (probescan); bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py (proofgate); cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_only_the_gate_writes_a_certificate.py (artifactgate). Read: the validations of test_delete_gate, test_artifact_gate, test_askscan, test_probescan, test_proof_gate each carry a one-entry closure (the proof).. Assumed: an extensionless file run through exec is code (bin/cmd/* are python with a shebang); a no-suffix data file is never exec'd, so keeping exec'd no-suffix files cannot pull data into a closure.
answers.builder_check: In cairn/devices/tester/device.py, the exec audit hook keeps a code object's co_filename when it is a repo file, not only when it ends '.py' (an exec event is CODE being run, so a data read never enters). In cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py, repo_relative_closure keeps an extensionless rel path that the run executed (e.g. bin/cmd/<name>), still dropping data files; the narrowest form keeps '.py' OR a file with no suffix. Proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_an_extensionless_module_loaded_by_path_is_in_the_seals_closure.py under PROVES this ticket's id, clauses 1-3, modelled on cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_module_loaded_by_path_is_in_the_seals_closure.py (a CAIRN_*_FIXTURE env re-run of itself that loads an extensionless tester-owned leaf by path). After the build, reseal the 9 blind proofs' validations so their closures name what they load. The prior art's fixture pattern is the template; do not change the closure's component-ownership filter (_owned_by_the_proofs_component) — bin/cmd/* is bin's, same as bin/proofs/*. The validation_store edit is one predicate in a tool the tester uses (tools have users, Law 6).
